children.name: event_engine_worker_base_url
children.label: Event Engine worker
children.help_text: Which Event Engine Worker serves checkout, registration, availability badges and corporate admin. Theme fields cannot be free-text, so pick one here; individual modules can still override. Production is event-engine.refuel-creative.workers.dev and is correct for the live site. The Worker formerly deployed as event-engine-staging was RENAMED to event-engine and that hostname no longer resolves, so anything still pointing at it takes checkout down - do not put it back. The Dev portal must select Development explicitly.
